claim.value: A stated future roster date followed by publication around that date without setup assistance would support deliberate delay.
claim.scope: The complete proposed timing-and-assistance pattern; not an established finding.

provenance.rationale: The bundle supplies the full pattern, its proposed interpretation and its hypothetical status.

signal_basis.value: Elicit customers' intended publication timing and preparation circumstances, then observe publication near the stated future roster date without setup assistance.
signal_basis.scope: A proposed observation limited to observed customer types and follow-up, subject to recall, event accuracy and missing offline activity.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans establish the inquiry, complete observed pattern, hypothetical status and relevant limits.
The claim is supported without a separate unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Publication near a previously stated intended date provides corroboration of deliberate waiting. Its occurrence without setup assistance further supports that interpretation. This licenses the claim's modest evidential support, without establishing deliberate delay as the sole cause.
uncertainty: Offline preparation or other obstacles could also resolve near the roster date. Recall and event accuracy constrain the strength of the support.
